art.note: Original combinations and names. Official CC0 trait parts only. Not numbered on-chain Nouns.

partner.name: Flamingo at the Net
partner.report: Light teal body, big red stripes, a flamingo head, watermelon noggles. Takes the net and stays there.

lineJudge.name: The Call
lineJudge.report: Foggrey body, a black tie, a triangular ruler for a head, black noggles. Wide is wide.

crowd.name: Box Seats
crowd.report: Gold body, sparkles, a crown, saturated yellow noggles. Came dressed for the final.

crowd.name: Pier Seat
crowd.report: Peachy body, a ducky, a wave for a head, guava noggles. Watching from the pier rail.

crowd.name: Ice Pop Row
crowd.report: Computerblue body, a snowflake, an icepop head, smoke noggles. Here for the changeover.

crowd.name: Whale Row
crowd.report: Darkbrown body, a sun on the shirt, a whale head, light grey noggles. Big shadow in the cheap seats.

crowd.name: Cotton Candy
crowd.report: Darkpink body, a yay on the shirt, a cotton-candy head, pink-purple noggles. Cheers either way.

favorite.name: The Baseline Kid
favorite.report: Teal body, a safety vest, a skateboard head, square teal noggles. Holds the line and rolls in.

favorite.name: Strand Ace
favorite.report: Blue-sky body, a wave, a sailboat head, square blue noggles. The serve leaves with the tide.

favorite.name: The Lobster
favorite.report: Red body, a shrimp, a crab head, square red noggles. Lobs up and pinches the reply.

favorite.name: Last Light
favorite.report: Orange-yellow body, a sunset gradient, a sunset head, yellow-orange noggles. Plays the last warm light.

favorite.name: Pier Return
favorite.report: Peachy body, an old shirt, an island head, hip-rose noggles. Returns from the pier.

favorite.name: Sandcastle
favorite.report: Yellow body, a cloud, a sand-castle head, honey noggles. Builds the point and hopes the tide waits.

favorite.name: The Grouper
favorite.report: Green body, a leaf, a grouper head, frog-green noggles. Sits deep and waits.

favorite.name: Net Cord
favorite.report: Bluegrey body, medium blue stripes, a volleyball head, saturated blue noggles. Wrong ball, same rally.

favorite.name: Club Mix
favorite.report: Magenta body, stripes and checks, a boombox head, square magenta noggles. Keeps the club mix through the changeover.

favorite.name: Anchor
favorite.report: Cold body, an anchor, an orca head, deep-teal noggles. Heavy first serve. Stays in the water.
